steps.note: On a five minute recording the clip was one long coloured bar, so the only way to find a moment was to play or scrub. The user chose (2026-09-25): at Fit the clip stays the mock's coloured bar, and opened out far enough for a frame to be recognisable, small pictures of what is in it fade in along it. Next defaults, no switch turned on. Every zoom and move is judged on the longest single pass of the main thread after it, at 50ms.
Fit: the whole five minutes across the width, and the clip is its plain coloured bar with its name, no pictures
one press in (2x): pictures of the recording fade in along the clip, the colour kept as a band along the top and the name in a dark pill
16x, about twenty seconds across the width: each picture is about a second of the recording

the clip picked: the accent ring round it still says so over the pictures, and its name stays in its pill. Not timed: picking rebuilds the right hand panel, which is its own cost (about 60ms here, the clip bar drawn once)

scrolling along the recording at that zoom, a third of the window at a time, the way dragging the overview bar does: the pictures slide with the clip and the new ones fill in, the main thread never held

and a jump of the playhead to three quarters, which carries the window there: pictures fill in where it lands. Not timed: the first long jump on a zoomed, captioned five minute recording holds the main thread about half a second with or without pictures, filed on its own
Fit puts the whole recording back, and the clip is its coloured bar again
